description.en: Planned animal asset: broad heavy frog skull and squat powerful frog body.
description.zh: 规划中的动物资产：宽厚蛙头骨与矮壮有力的蛙体。

scientific_scope.en: Living reconstruction proposal, not a scanned specimen. A named museum or primary reference supports identity and specified evidence. The proposed whole form and low-poly distinction still require the listed production gate. Includes stem tetrapods; not automatically crown Amphibia.
scientific_scope.zh: 活体复原方案，并非扫描标本。具名博物馆或一手资料支持身份及指定证据。拟议整体形态与低多边形差异仍须通过所列制作关卡。 此栏包含干群四足类，不自动等同冠群两栖类。

distinctness.en: Shape criterion: broad heavy frog skull and squat powerful frog body. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
distinctness.zh: 形态判据：宽厚蛙头骨与矮壮有力的蛙体。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block broad heavy frog skull and squat powerful frog body with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织宽厚蛙头骨与矮壮有力的蛙体；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

uncertainty: Skin, color and unpreserved soft tissues are not established by this inventory. Choose a species and specimen before final anatomy approval.

reference_notes.en: Beelzebufo ampinga: Maastrichtian, heavily ornamented skull with posterolateral flanges and sculptured vertebral spine tables; revised anatomy rather than simply an enlarged modern frog. Taxon-specific source checked; this does not approve every proposed reconstruction detail.
reference_notes.zh: 已核实该属的专门资料；所列来源仅支持相应身份与结构，不代表全部复原细节已获批准。

sources.title: Fossil Record of the Amphibia
sources.supports: Broad fossil amphibian/stem-tetrapod diversity, including horned and limbless forms, plus named Ichthyostega.

sources.title: New material of Beelzebufo, a hyperossified frog from the Late Cretaceous of Madagascar
sources.supports: Beelzebufo ampinga: Maastrichtian, heavily ornamented skull with posterolateral flanges and sculptured vertebral spine tables; revised anatomy rather than simply an enlarged modern frog.
